import type { StorageInstance } from '../protocol.ts';
export interface ConformanceTables {
    conformance_account: {
        id: string;
        name: string;
    };
    conformance_counter: {
        id: string;
        value: number;
    };
    conformance_parent: {
        id: string;
    };
    conformance_child: {
        id: string;
        parent_id: string;
    };
    conformance_checked: {
        id: string;
        n: number;
    };
}
export declare const CONFORMANCE_UNIQUE_CONSTRAINT = "conformance_account_name_unique";
export declare function describeStorageConformance(name: string, factory: () => Promise<StorageInstance>): void;
